subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should this protected PR be closed as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100027, or should the local Anthropic Vertex client approach be rebuilt on current main?
rationale: The central dependency-chain cleanup is already on current main, but the PR is protected by maintainer/human-review labels and the remaining choice is a maintainer-owned auth-provider/dependency-boundary decision.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Confirm that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100027 is the canonical fix for the dependency/auth chain, then close this stale PR and route https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95366 to release/current-main proof.

options.title: Rebuild The Local Client
options.body: If maintainers want to remove the official Vertex SDK entirely, rebuild this as a fresh current-main PR that preserves cache-control behavior, declares provider-owned runtime deps, regenerates shrinkwraps, and proves live Vertex ADC.

options.title: Hold For Release Proof
options.body: Keep this PR open only as a temporary pointer while validating whether the current-main dependency update resolves the reported Node 25+/26 auth failure in a release candidate.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Confirm that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100027 is the canonical fix for the dependency/auth chain, then close this stale PR and route https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95366 to release/current-main proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc previously requested automerge on this PR and has recent ownership signals on the Anthropic Vertex plugin packaging/runtime boundary.
